tha-ap305:1.1: samattaṃ. [303. Paramannadāyaka.] Kaṇikāraṃ va jotantam udayantaṃ va bhāṇumaṃ / Vipassim addasaṃ Buddhaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ. // //
tha-ap305:2.1: Añjaliṃ paggahetvāna atinesiṃ sakaṃ gharaṃ / atinetvāna sambuddhaṃ paramannam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap305:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe paramannam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi paramannass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap305:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Paramannadāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
